profile.headline: Data warehouse consultant
profile.summary:
I have worked as a DW consultant for over 12 years with leading datawarehouse technologies such as Ab Initio, Oracle, Netezza, Teradata, Business Objects, Microstrategy, open source Hadoop, Hive, Pentaho

Cloudera Certified Hadoop Developer and Administrator


Also have experience configuring Oracle Grid/RAC databases.

Specialties: Finance, Telecom, Services, Federal Government

positions.title: Federal Database Lead
positions.description:
Lead DBA responsible for managing mission critical databases within Customs and Border Protections/Department of Homeland Security.

Extensive experience with Oracle Real Application Clusters and ETL/BI technologies

positions.title: Sr. Datawarehouse Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as an Ab Initio Sr. Datawarehouse Consultant with a reputed Datawarehouse consulting company and worked for clients like Qwest (Denver, CO) America Online (Dulles, VA) and Fannie Mae (Washington DC)

Leadership, Mentoring and Training Junior developers.

Consulting Experience with companies like Knightsbridge Solutions, LLC and TCS

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as ETL Designer (Ab Initio) to create Enterprise Datawarehouse for AOL.

Responsibilities - Offsite coordination, Graph design etc.

positions.title: DW Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as an Ab Initio Consultant @ Knightsbridge Solution, LLC.

Direct Client Fannie Mae.
Conversion project used Ab Initio to migrate data (book of business) from legacy to their new system, CORE
